# Third-party research code

This directory contains the vendored research implementations used by the integrated model adapters:

- [PMP](PMP-master/): Partitioning Message Passing.
- [SEC-GFD](SEC-GFD-main/): spectral and local-environment graph fraud detection.

Upstream files, notices, and licenses are retained unchanged. These directories were formerly under `Repos/`. Other literature-reference clones remain local and ignored.

The submitted Kaggle notebook independently downloads pinned upstream revisions; it does not load these local copies. Consult the [execution manifest](../gfd-robustness-v4-factorial-report-r1/kaggle_run_manifest.json) and [original bundle description](../gfd-robustness-v4-factorial-report-r1/REPORT_BUNDLE_README.txt) for the revisions used in the completed run.
